name: Lab 8 - Viajes de taxi en Nueva York
description: Indicadores de los viajes de taxis amarillos y verdes de Nueva York (TLC), calculados con DuckDB sobre la tabla materializada data/processed/taxi.duckdb.

cards.name: Viajes analizados
cards.description: ¿Cuántos viajes válidos contiene el conjunto de datos?
cards.query:
SELECT
    count(*) AS trips,
    round(sum(total_amount) / 1e6, 1) AS revenue_musd,
    round(avg(total_amount), 2) AS avg_ticket,
    count(DISTINCT source_year) AS years,
    min(make_date(source_year, source_month, 1)) AS first_month,
    max(make_date(source_year, source_month, 1)) AS last_month
FROM trips_clean;

cards.name: Ingreso total (millones de USD)
cards.query:
SELECT
    count(*) AS trips,
    round(sum(total_amount) / 1e6, 1) AS revenue_musd,
    round(avg(total_amount), 2) AS avg_ticket,
    count(DISTINCT source_year) AS years,
    min(make_date(source_year, source_month, 1)) AS first_month,
    max(make_date(source_year, source_month, 1)) AS last_month
FROM trips_clean;

cards.name: Monto promedio por viaje (USD)
cards.description: ¿Cuánto paga en promedio un pasajero por viaje?
cards.query:
SELECT
    count(*) AS trips,
    round(sum(total_amount) / 1e6, 1) AS revenue_musd,
    round(avg(total_amount), 2) AS avg_ticket,
    count(DISTINCT source_year) AS years,
    min(make_date(source_year, source_month, 1)) AS first_month,
    max(make_date(source_year, source_month, 1)) AS last_month
FROM trips_clean;

cards.name: I1 · Viajes por día según mes
cards.description: ¿Cómo evoluciona la demanda diaria de cada tipo de taxi?
cards.query:
SELECT
    make_date(source_year, source_month, 1) AS month,
    taxi_type,
    round(count(*) / count(DISTINCT CAST(pickup_datetime AS DATE)), 0) AS trips_per_day
FROM trips_clean
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY month, taxi_type;

cards.name: I2 · Ingreso mensual (millones de USD)
cards.description: ¿Cuánto ingreso genera cada mes y qué parte aporta cada tipo de taxi?
cards.query:
SELECT
    make_date(source_year, source_month, 1) AS month,
    taxi_type,
    round(sum(total_amount) / 1e6, 2) AS revenue_musd
FROM trips_clean
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY month, taxi_type;

cards.name: I3 · Monto promedio por viaje (USD)
cards.description: ¿Está subiendo lo que paga un pasajero por viaje?
cards.query:
SELECT
    make_date(source_year, source_month, 1) AS month,
    taxi_type,
    round(avg(total_amount), 2) AS avg_ticket
FROM trips_clean
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY month, taxi_type;

cards.name: I4 · Propina con tarjeta (% de la tarifa)
cards.description: ¿Qué tan generosas son las propinas y cambian con el tiempo?
cards.query:
SELECT
    make_date(source_year, source_month, 1) AS month,
    taxi_type,
    round(100.0 * sum(tip_amount) / sum(fare_amount), 2) AS tip_pct_of_fare
FROM trips_clean
WHERE payment_type = 1
  AND fare_amount > 0
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY month, taxi_type;

cards.name: I5 · Distribución de viajes por hora (%)
cards.description: ¿En qué horas se concentra la demanda de cada tipo de taxi?
cards.query:
SELECT
    hour(pickup_datetime) AS hour,
    taxi_type,
    round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY taxi_type), 2) AS pct_of_trips
FROM trips_clean
GROUP BY hour(pickup_datetime), taxi_type
ORDER BY hour, taxi_type;

cards.name: I6 · Velocidad mediana por hora (mph)
cards.description: ¿A qué horas el tráfico hace más lentos los viajes?
cards.query:
SELECT
    hour(pickup_datetime) AS hour,
    round(approx_quantile(trip_distance / (duration_minutes / 60), 0.5), 1) AS median_mph,
    round(approx_quantile(duration_minutes, 0.5), 1) AS median_minutes
FROM trips_clean
WHERE duration_minutes >= 1
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY hour;

cards.name: I7 · Medio de pago por año (%)
cards.description: ¿Cómo pagan los pasajeros y está cambiando la forma de pago?
cards.query:
SELECT
    CAST(source_year AS VARCHAR) AS year,
    CASE payment_type
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Tarjeta'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Efectivo'
        WHEN 0 THEN 'Flex fare'
        ELSE 'Otro o nulo'
    END AS payment,
    round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY source_year), 2) AS pct_of_trips
FROM trips_clean
GROUP BY source_year, payment
ORDER BY year, pct_of_trips DESC;

cards.name: I8 · Peso de los aeropuertos (%)
cards.description: ¿Qué parte de los viajes y del ingreso viene de los aeropuertos?
cards.query:
WITH classified AS (
    SELECT
        t.source_year,
        t.total_amount,
        'Airports' IN (pu.service_zone, do_.service_zone)
            OR 'EWR' IN (pu.service_zone, do_.service_zone) AS is_airport
    FROM trips_clean AS t
    LEFT JOIN zones AS pu ON pu.location_id = t.PULocationID
    LEFT JOIN zones AS do_ ON do_.location_id = t.DOLocationID
)
SELECT
    CAST(source_year AS VARCHAR) AS year,
    round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_airport) / count(*), 2) AS pct_trips,
    round(100.0 * sum(total_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_airport) / sum(total_amount), 2) AS pct_revenue
FROM classified
GROUP BY source_year
ORDER BY year;

cards.name: I9 · Participación de los taxis verdes (%)
cards.description: ¿Están perdiendo terreno los taxis verdes frente a los amarillos?
cards.query:
SELECT
    make_date(source_year, source_month, 1) AS month,
    round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE taxi_type = 'green') / count(*), 2) AS green_pct
FROM trips_clean
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY month;

cards.name: I10 · Zonas con más abordajes
cards.query:
SELECT
    z.zone || ' (' || z.borough || ')' AS zone,
    count(*) AS trips
FROM trips_clean AS t
JOIN zones AS z ON z.location_id = t.PULocationID
WHERE z.borough NOT IN ('Unknown', 'N/A')
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY trips DESC
LIMIT 10;

cards.name: I11 · Cargo de congestión CBD (millones de USD)
cards.description: ¿Cuánto recauda el cargo de congestión de Manhattan desde que existe?
cards.query:
SELECT
    make_date(source_year, source_month, 1) AS month,
    round(coalesce(sum(cbd_congestion_fee), 0) / 1e6, 2) AS cbd_fee_musd,
    round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE cbd_congestion_fee > 0) / count(*), 1) AS pct_trips_with_fee
FROM trips_clean
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY month;
